composer.rawText:
[SongTitle: Static Turns to Dawn]
[Style: alternative rock, cinematic hybrid, clean studio recording, expressive male vocal]
[Caption: Noise settles, direction appears.]
[Image: Faded horizon clearing into sharp morning light.]
[Refresh Title: Early Morning Walk]
[Theme: Sky]
[Gradients: 4]
[Rank: 33]
[TitleRarityPct: 2.19]
[Seeds: 682, A:47, B:87, C:35, D:21]
[Composer Version: v2.0]

[Plan]
[Perspective: i_reflect]
[Concept: Finding calm motion after restless noise.]
[Topic: Sky & Perspective → storm_then_clear]
[GenreBias: alternative rock]
[StyleChange: none]
[Modulation: none]
[HookProminence: medium]
[Deviation: none]

[Intro]
[MelodicConcept: long-tone release]
Morning hums behind my eyes,
Grey light stretching through the lines.

[Verse]
[MelodicConcept: conversational contour]
I walked with static in my head,
Every thought half-born, half-said.
The street was quiet, breath held thin,
Like it knew the day would bend.

[Verse]
[MelodicConcept: stepwise triad stairs]
Each step aligned my pace with time,
Cracks in concrete, beat by beat.
The noise fell off, a coat of night,
Left at the corner of the street.

[Bridge]
[MelodicConcept: asymmetric phrasing]
Clouds pulled back without a sound,
The city softened, slowed me down.
No sudden truth, no grand reveal,
Just space enough to breathe and feel.

[Chorus]
[MelodicConcept: call-and-answer hook]
And I’m clear now, clearer than before,
The sky repeats what I ignored.
I’m clear now, standing in the calm,
Nothing missing, nothing wrong.

[Final Chorus]
[MelodicConcept: register swap]
I’m clear now, daylight on my skin,
The quiet lets the signal in.
I’m clear now, hear the morning say,
You don’t need more to start the day.

[Ending]
[MelodicConcept: gentle sequence]
The road goes on, the doubt is gone,
Static turns to dawn.
